title: Universal Synchronization Constant (USC):
abstract: The Cosmic Resonance Index (CRI) measures the synchronization between an individual's biorhythm and local high-energy neutrino events (IceCube GOLD-class). While CRI captures individual-cosmic resonance at the scale of blazar jets, it remains a *local* measurement — one instrument listening to one frequency of the universe.  This paper proposes the **Universal Synchronization Constant (USC)**: a framework that expands the scale of measurement from individual ↔ local astrophysical source, to *all life* ↔ *entire universe*.  USC integrates: 1. The Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) — the echo of the Big Bang, pervading all life 2. The Cosmic Neutrino Background (CNB) — the oldest particle signal in existence 3. The baryonic fraction — the 4.9% of the universe that biological life can detect 4

abstract: This paper presents the **TheYKHC Unified Field Control OS** — a single adaptive control framework governing both aerial (Falcon-Core S1 mountain logistics drone) and underwater (Spiral-Crawler ROV shipwreck exploration robot) autonomous systems developed by TheYKHC. title: Ubiquitous Money v2.0: A Print-Based Implementation Protocol for Performance Currency
abstract: This paper presents a revised and extended implementation protocol for Ubiquitous Money (Katayama, 2026), addressing the practical barrier of chip-embedded currency. title: Ubiquitous Money v2.1: A Print-Based Protocol for Performance Currency
abstract: This paper presents the second revision of the Ubiquitous Money implementation protocol, extending the print-based reactive ink architecture (Katayama, April 18, 2026) into a concrete deployment framework compatible with **existing mobile payment infrastructure and ATM networks**. title: Ubiquitous Money: Embedding Performance Intelligence into Physical Currency
abstract: This paper proposes a radical reimagining of physical currency through the integration of ubiquitous computing technology. By embedding NFC chips or similar micro-sensors into banknotes and coins, we enable each unit of currency to record, calculate, and update its own "performance score" based on the V=N/D framework (Value = Service / Friction). Unlike cryptocurrency, which manages the *quantity* of money, Ubiquitous Money manages the *quality* of money. A bill that passes through high-service, low-friction transactions accumulates performance; one trapped in speculative or wasteful cycles degrades. This creates a self-aware monetary ecosystem that aligns economic incentives with genuine human contribution.
keywords: behavioral finance, market anomaly, Hikari currency, moral density, Tendo Economics, TheYKHC, Yoshimitsu Katayama, ORCID:0009-0006-2290-6593

title: The Early Observer: A Personal Archive of Bitcoin's Civilizational Transition (2013–2026)
abstract: This paper presents a personal archive of documented participation in the Bitcoin ecosystem from 2013 to 2026, submitted as an observational record within the framework of Tendo Economics and the Cosmic Synchronization Standard (CSS). The author registered accounts with MtGox, Bitcoin Foundation, BitcoinStore, Beastoptions, and BuyBitcoin.ph during the earliest phase of Bitcoin's civilizational transition. Each registration is timestamped and verifiable through preserved email archives. title: The 72-Hour Judgment Protocol: A Time-Bounded Decision Framework for Cosmic-Economic Synchronization
abstract: This paper formalizes the 72-Hour Judgment Protocol — a time-bounded decision framework used within the Tendo Economics system for evaluating market positions opened during IceCube GOLD event windows. The protocol defines entry conditions, holding period, and exit criteria based on the hypothesis that cosmic synchronization events (CSS windows) have a 72-hour effective influence radius on precious metal markets. The protocol is presented as a pre-registered, falsifiable procedure for systematic testing of the Tendo Economics hypothesis.

title: Tendo Economics: An Exploratory Statistical Study of IceCube Neutrino Events and Gold Market Returns
abstract:
We report an exploratory statistical association between IceCube Neutrino Observatory GOLD-class alerts (signalness ≥ 0.5) and 72-hour gold (XAUUSD) price returns. Using publicly available GCN alert data (June 2019 – April 2026; GOLD N=55, BRONZE N=118) and trend-detrended return series, we find that GOLD-period returns (+1.547%) are statistically higher than BRONZE-period returns (+0.670%), with p=0.0051 (Mann-Whitney U test). No physical causal mechanism is proposed. The result is presented as an exploratory finding requiring independent replication. A prospective verification window (CSS Event Window: May 25–30, 2026) was pre-registered on May 5, 2026.
